cases.title: After a first drawing in which nothing was placed was closed and a fresh copy reopened in the same AutoCAD, a downpipe places (BUG-1225 reopen-only test)
cases.plan_item: BUG-1225 (DP refused after a drawing is reopened)
cases.expected: On the reopened copy, DP at 150000,-80000 prints 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP<n>.'; no 'could not be refreshed' in the history.
cases.why_not_unit: The refusal comes from the live drawing's landing index after a real close and reopen in the same AutoCAD.
not_automated: Whether a drafter's own close-without-save and reopen behaves the same as the runner's reopen-copy is not established by this case.
